title: Difficulty-Aware Sample Allocation for Adaptive Data Augmentation in Semantic Segmentation
summary: Data augmentation is a standard component of modern semantic segmentation pipelines, but most augmentation techniques allocate transformations uniformly across training samples or adapt to a single difficulty signal such as loss. This ignores the fact that segmentation difficulty is multi-factorial, since ambiguous predictions, persistent optimization errors, rare classes, and complex object boundaries can each make a sample informative in different ways. This paper introduces Difficulty-Aware Sample Allocation (DASA), an architecture-agnostic framework that assigns stronger augmentation to samples estimated to be more difficult. DASA combines prediction ambiguity, training loss, class rarity, and boundary complexity into a normalized difficulty score, then maps that score to sample-specific augmentation strength during iterative training. Experiments on Oxford-IIIT Pet and binary Pascal VOC segmentation with U-Net, DeepLabV3, and SegFormer-B0 show that DASA improves over standard training and is competitive with or stronger than single-signal adaptive baselines. On Oxford-IIIT Pet, DASA improves DeepLabV3 from 0.633 to 0.740 mIoU. On binary Pascal VOC, DASA obtains the best foreground IoU for all three evaluated architectures. These results attest to the value of multi-factor difficulty estimation as a practical mechanism for directing augmentation where it is most useful.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Difficulty-Aware Sample Allocation (DASA)框架，根据预测模糊度、训练损失、类别稀有度和边界复杂度等多维困难因素，为不同样本分配差异化的数据增强强度，提升语义分割性能。
AI.motivation: 现有数据增强方法对所有训练样本均匀分配变换或仅基于单一困难信号（如损失值）进行自适应，忽略了分割困难的多维性——模糊预测、优化错误、稀有类别和复杂边界都会以不同方式使样本变得重要。
AI.method: DASA是一个架构无关的框架，它将预测模糊度、训练损失、类别稀有度和边界复杂度整合为标准化的困难分数，在迭代训练过程中将该分数映射到样本特定的增强强度。实验在Oxford-IIIT Pet和二值Pascal VOC数据集上使用U-Net、DeepLabV3和SegFormer-B0进行评估。
AI.result: 在Oxford-IIIT Pet上，DASA将DeepLabV3的mIoU从0.633提升至0.740。在二值Pascal VOC上，DASA在所有三种架构上获得最佳前景IoU。
AI.conclusion: 多因素困难估计是指导增强资源分配的有效实用机制，DASA在多个数据集和架构上优于标准训练和单信号自适应基线，验证了多维困难估计的价值。

title: LongVU-TTT: Causal Test-Time Training for Visual Resampling in Long Video Understanding
summary: Long-video MLLMs must model temporal change before a limited visual-token budget removes most frame evidence. We introduce LongVU-TTT, which inserts a convolutional Test-Time Training (TTT) resampler with causal fast-weight updates between the vision encoder and the LLM. Its grouped 2D fast weights adapt to each video and contextualize frame features before compression, while a hybrid uniform-and-change-aware selector retains explicit visual evidence for downstream reasoning. Under controlled conditions, TTT-Conv improves over TTT-MLP by up to +2.12 and bidirectional Mamba2 by up to +3.04 on MLVU, and it is stronger than attention- and fixed-state recurrent resamplers across three benchmarks. Analysis shows that the fast weights behave as a temporal aggregation state rather than a reliable long-horizon episodic memory: their benefit attenuates as evidence becomes more distant, motivating explicit frame retention. LongVU-TTT processes up to 512 frames before reducing them to 128 LLM frames and achieves competitive performance across five video understanding benchmarks.

AI.tldr: LongVU-TTT是一种长视频多模态大语言模型，通过在视觉编码器和LLM之间插入卷积测试时训练(TTT)重采样器来解决有限视觉token预算导致大部分帧证据丢失的问题。该方法使用分组2D快速权重适应每个视频并在压缩前对帧特征进行上下文处理，同时使用混合均匀且变化感知的选择器保留明确的视觉证据。
AI.motivation: 长视频多模态大语言模型必须在有限的视觉token预算下建模时间变化，但大多数帧证据会被丢弃。需要一种方法在压缩前有效地聚合和上下文处理帧特征。
AI.method:
1. 在视觉编码器和LLM之间插入卷积TTT重采样器，具有因果快速权重更新
2. 分组2D快速权重适应每个视频，在压缩前对帧特征进行上下文处理
3. 混合均匀且变化感知的选择器保留明确的视觉证据用于下游推理
4. 处理最多512帧，然后将其减少到128个LLM帧
AI.result: TTT-Conv相比TTT-MLP在MLVU上提升高达+2.12，相比双向Mamba2提升高达+3.04。在三个基准测试中优于注意力和固定状态循环重采样器。在五个视频理解基准测试中达到竞争性性能。
AI.conclusion: 快速权重表现为时间聚合状态而非可靠的长期情景记忆，其优势随着证据距离增加而衰减，这验证了显式帧保留的必要性。LongVU-TTT成功实现了高效的长视频处理和理解。

While both involve video processing, this paper focuses on visual token compression and video QA, not on extracting visual guidance features for 3D motion transformation or motion generation. The methods (TTT resampling for LLM-based video understanding) do not align with the research profile's focus on video-to-3D motion generation, quality control in motion transformation, or visual guidance feature extraction for motion synthesis.

title: MIMONet: Multi-scale Input and Multi-scale Output Network for Salient Object Detection
summary: The existing methods for saliency detection task focus on the application of multi-level features, aiming to take advantage of the respective strengths of high- and low-level features. However, because the inputs of these models are single-size images, their multi-level features have difficulty in learning the knowledge of size variations of salient objects. Object-scale variation learning has great potential for detecting multi-scale objects, which has not been fully explored by existing methods. To improve the recognition ability of a model for objects with different sizes, we are inspired by the image pyramid to propose a Multi-scale Input and Multi-scale Output Network (MIMONet). In MIMONet, we extract multi-level features for three images with different resolutions to form three encoder branches, and information will be exchanged between the branches. The advantage of this approach is that the features of one branch can learn the knowledge of target size variation from the features of the other two branches. In addition, we design a Multi-scale Perception (MSP) module, in which the input feature layer is divided into several sub-layers with different resolutions. Capturing the multi-level structure information of the objects in these sub-layers can make the objects more fully perceived. For network training, we propose a Joint Saliency Loss (JSL), which can constrain multiple saliency maps output by the network to identify the same foreground objects, and induce their boundaries to be preserved clearly. Experimental results show that MIMONet has stronger detection capabilities and harvests better evaluation scores on multiple datasets compared to existing models. The code of our model will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MIMONet网络，通过多尺度输入和多尺度输出架构解决显著性检测中目标尺度变化学习不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有显著性检测方法虽利用多层次特征，但输入为单尺度图像，难以学习显著目标的尺度变化知识。
AI.method: 提出MIMONet网络，包含三个不同分辨率图像的编码器分支实现特征交互；设计多尺度感知模块(MSP)将输入特征层分为不同分辨率子层；提出联合显著性损失(JSL)约束多个输出显著性图识别相同前景目标并清晰保留边界。
AI.result: 实验表明MIMONet在多个数据集上具有更强的检测能力和更好的评估分数。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度输入输出架构能有效提升模型对不同尺度显著目标的检测能力。

title: InteractGesture: Progressive Chunk Guidance for Continuous Streaming Co-Speech Gesture Control
summary: Co-speech gesture generation has made significant progress toward realistic full-body motion from speaker audio, yet existing models lack fine-grained spatial controllability of individual joints. To address this, we introduce \emph{InteractGesture}, a model-agnostic, inference-time method for spatially controllable gesture generation. \emph{InteractGesture} guides target latent estimates of a diffusion sampler through a differentiable RVQ-VAE decoder, backpropagating spatial control gradients to adjust motion latents during sampling. A primary challenge in streaming co-speech generation is chunk-wise dependency: standard sequential inference freezes prior chunks, preventing spatial constraints in future chunks from adjusting preceding trajectories and causing boundary inconsistencies. To overcome this limitation, we propose \emph{Progressive Chunk Guidance}, a chunk-window strategy that maintains an active set of editable chunk latents with staggered delays, enabling spatial constraints to propagate gradients backward across chunk boundaries during streaming generation. Experiments on the BEAT2 dataset show that \emph{InteractGesture} improves multi-joint spatial control while preserving overall gesture quality. Furthermore, our approach supports diverse applications, including sparse joint positioning, dense joint trajectory control, and directional pointing. Our project page is available at https://exitudio.github.io/interactgesture-page .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了InteractGesture，一个模型无关的推理时方法，用于实现可空间控制的语音伴随手势生成。该方法通过可微分的RVQ-VAE解码器引导扩散采样器的目标潜在估计，通过反向传播空间控制梯度来调整采样过程中的运动潜在变量。同时提出渐进分块引导策略，解决流式生成中分块依赖导致的边界不一致问题。在BEAT2数据集上的实验表明，该方法在保持手势整体质量的同时提升了多关节空间控制能力。
AI.motivation: 现有语音伴随手势生成模型缺乏对单个关节的细粒度空间可控性。此外，流式共语生成中存在分块依赖问题：标准顺序推理会冻结前面的分块，阻止空间约束调整先前的轨迹并导致边界不一致。
AI.method: 1. InteractGesture：通过可微分的RVQ-VAE解码器引导扩散采样器的目标潜在估计，反向传播空间控制梯度以在采样过程中调整运动潜在变量。2. 渐进分块引导(Progressive Chunk Guidance)：保持一组具有交错延迟的可编辑分块潜在变量，使空间约束能够在流式生成过程中跨分块边界反向传播梯度。
AI.result: 在BEAT2数据集上的实验表明，InteractGesture在保持整体手势质量的同时提升了多关节空间控制能力。该方法支持多种应用场景，包括稀疏关节定位、密集关节轨迹控制和方向指向。
AI.conclusion: InteractGesture是一个模型无关的方法，可在推理时为现有的手势生成模型添加空间可控性，具有广泛的应用潜力。

title: Moving Beyond More Views: Redundancy-Aware Ego-Exo Fusion for Proficiency Estimation
summary: EgoExo proficiency estimation aims to assess action quality by integrating fine-grained motion cues from egocentric (1st-person) views with spatial context from multiple exocentric (3rd-person) views. Simply adding more exocentric views degrades EgoExo performance, as redundant or noisy perspectives dilute useful motion cues. Our analysis identifies two key causes: (1) Multiview redundancy - From the data perspective, certain views provide limited or noisy information, diluting discriminative cues; (2) Overfitting - From the feature perspective, conventional fusion increases representational complexity, causing the model to memorise view-specific patterns rather than learn generalisable representations. To address these issues, we propose two complementary modules: AdaMVS, which adaptively identifies and fuses the most informative view tokens under weak supervision from the data perspective, and VIB-GB, which combines Gradient Blending and Variational Information Bottleneck regularisation from the feature perspective to compress redundant signals and suppress overfitting during training. Experiments on EgoExo-4D and EgoExo-Fitness demonstrate that our method learns both which view to look at and how to fuse them, achieving new state-of-the-art results. Our source code is available at https://github.com/dx199771/AdaMVS

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaMVS和VIB-GB两个模块来解决EgoExo proficiency estimation中多视角融合导致的性能下降问题，实现动作质量评估的 state-of-the-art。
AI.motivation: EgoExo proficiency estimation通过融合第一人称视角的细粒度运动线索和第三人称视角的空间上下文来评估动作质量。然而，简单添加更多外视角反而会降低性能，原因包括：(1)多视角冗余-某些视角信息有限或含有噪声，稀释了判别性线索；(2)过拟合-传统融合增加了表示复杂度，导致模型记忆视角特定模式而非学习可泛化表示。
AI.method: 提出两个互补模块：(1) AdaMVS - 从数据角度自适应识别和融合信息量最大的视角tokens，利用弱监督信号；(2) VIB-GB - 结合梯度混合(Gradient Blending)和变分信息瓶颈(VIB)正则化，从特征角度压缩冗余信号并抑制训练过拟合。
AI.result: 在EgoExo-4D和EgoExo-Fitness数据集上实验表明，方法学会了关注哪些视角以及如何融合它们，取得了新的state-of-the-art结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过数据驱动的视角选择和特征正则化相结合的方法，有效解决了多视角融合中的冗余和过拟合问题，为EgoExo动作质量评估提供了有效框架。

title: TDFNet: Tri-projection Deformable Fusion Network for Panoramic Salient Object Detection
summary: Recent years have witnessed the growing potential of panoramic salient object detection in robotic vision, virtual reality, and related applications. However, projecting spherical scenes onto 2D planes inevitably introduces geometric distortions, which fundamentally limit the effectiveness of existing projection-based methods. Specifically, Equirectangular Projection (ERP) suffers from severe polar stretching distortions, while cube map projection introduces discontinuities across cube-face boundaries, resulting in degraded feature discriminability and compromised geometric consistency. To address these limitations, we propose TDFNet, the first Tri-projection Deformable Fusion Network for panoramic salient object detection, exploiting complementary projection representations to alleviate geometric distortions and improve detection performance.Specifically, we design a cross-projection deformable attention (CDA) module that leverages spatial correspondences between different projections to construct geometry-aware sampling locations, guiding deformable attention for cross-projection contextual aggregation and enhancing robustness against projection-induced deformations. Furthermore, we introduce a latitude-guided fusion module, which utilizes spherical latitude priors to construct geometric confidence weights for adaptively balancing ERP and CMP features. Meanwhile, LGF incorporates distortion-reduced semantic references from Tangent Projection to achieve cross-projection feature refinement and spatial alignment.By constructing a three-branch encoding architecture based on ERP, CMP, and Tangent Projection, TDFNet simultaneously preserves global spatial continuity, local geometric details, and fine-grained boundary information.

AI.tldr: TDFNet是首个用于全景显著目标检测的三投影可变形融合网络，通过结合等距矩形投影、立方体映射投影和切线投影来缓解球面到2D投影带来的几何畸变问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于投影的全景显著目标检测方法存在几何失真问题：等距矩形投影(ERP)存在严重的极地拉伸畸变，立方体映射投影(CMP)在立方体面边界处存在不连续性，导致特征判别力下降和几何一致性受损。
AI.method: 提出三分支编码架构，基于ERP、CMP和切线投影同时保留全局空间连续性、局部几何细节和细粒度边界信息。核心模块包括：1)跨投影可变形注意力(CDA)模块，利用不同投影间的空间对应关系构建几何感知的采样位置；2)纬度引导融合模块(LGF)，利用球面纬度先验构建几何置信权重，并引入切线投影的低畸变语义参考进行跨投影特征细化和空间对齐。
AI.result: 该方法有效缓解了投影引起的几何畸变，提高了特征判别力和几何一致性，在全景显著目标检测任务中取得更好的检测性能。
AI.conclusion: TDFNet通过三投影融合策略，为全景显著目标检测提供了一种有效处理几何畸变的解决方案，为该领域后续研究提供了新的思路。

title: Label-Free Foundational Model Selection for Medical Image Classification under Distribution Shift via Pseudo Label Discrepancy
comment: Accepted at MIRASOL Workshop, MICCAI 2026. 10 pages, 3 figures
summary: Foundation models are increasingly deployed for medical image analysis. However, under the inter-institutional distribution shift typical of deployment, their performance varies widely and cannot be known without target-domain labels, which are rarely available. This leaves a practical question unresolved: given several candidate foundational models and labeled-data from a source domain, which one to deploy in an unlabeled target domain? We propose a label-free selection criterion built on SUDO, a framework for evaluating clinical AI systems without ground-truth annotations. SUDO partitions the unlabeled target data by predicted probability and, for each region, measures a pseudo-label discrepancy reflecting class contamination; aggregated across regions, this yields a score (AURCC) requiring neither target annotation nor fine-tuning. We show that AURCC can be used to rank a variety of vision-language models (BioMedCLIP, CXR-CLIP, CheXzero, MedCLIP, MedImageInsight, CLIP) on chest X-ray classification across three inter-hospital shift scenarios, under zero-shot and MLP-probe regimes. The AURCC ranking recovers the ground-truth ranking with Spearman rho up to 0.943 (p<0.05). Against the natural baseline of ranking by held-out source accuracy, AURCC is competitive when the labeled source is large and yields a more accurate ranking once it is small; the regime of interest in resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SUDO框架中的AURCC（Area Under Region-wise Contamination curve）指标，用于在无需目标域标注的情况下，选择最适合特定目标医院部署的基础模型。解决了跨机构医疗数据分布偏移下，模型性能不可知的问题。
AI.motivation: 基础模型在跨机构部署时性能波动大，且目标域标注数据稀缺，现有方法无法在无标签情况下评估模型在目标域的表现，导致无法选择最佳部署模型。
AI.method: SUDO框架通过将目标域数据按预测概率分区，测量每个区域的伪标签污染度（反映类别混杂程度），聚合后得到AURCC分数。该方法无需目标域标注和微调即可评估模型。
AI.result: 在三种跨医院迁移场景下，对6种视觉语言模型（BioMedCLIP、CXR-CLIP、CheXzero、MedCLIP、MedImageInsight、CLIP）进行胸部X光分类测试，AURCC排名与真实排名Spearman相关系数高达0.943（p<0.05）。当源域标注数据量大时与源域准确率基线相当，数据量小时表现更优。
AI.conclusion: AURCC可有效实现无标签目标域的模型选择，在资源受限场景（源域数据少）尤为有价值，为医疗AI的跨机构部署提供了实用的选择依据。

title: Steer the Sampling, Not the Kernel Grid: Geometry-Guided Sampling Operator for Volumetric Segmentation
summary: Accurate 3D segmentation is central to quantitative lesion assessment and anatomy mapping for clinical planning and follow-up. Thin, elongated, and fine anatomical/pathological structures (e.g., vessels) are a particularly challenging case: a one-voxel boundary error can disconnect a branch and change clinically relevant topology. In encoder-decoder networks (e.g., U-Net), repeated downsampling and fixed-grid convolution blur or alias fine structures and weaken orientation cues, so early mistakes propagate across scales. We propose a geometry-guided local operator that steers where features are sampled, rather than deforming convolutional kernels, under a single formulation for both feature refinement (stride 1) and resolution reduction (stride > 1). At each voxel, it predicts a local orientation and bounded step sizes, samples symmetrically along these directions, and transforms paired samples into compact geometric and boundary cues with lightweight mixing; a cross-scale consensus aligns encoder and decoder features at skip connections to reduce geometric mismatch. Replacing all stride 1 and stride 2 operators in a 3D U-Net yields consistent improvements on BraTS, MSD Hepatic Vessel, and TDSC-ABUS, with notably better boundary metrics (e.g., BraTS Dice 86.1 to 88.9, HD95 7.1 to 6.2; TDSC-ABUS HD95 39.1 to 27.8) while reducing parameters from 2.3M to 0.8M. We further demonstrate that the operator can be integrated into other backbones (e.g., nnU-Net, Swin-UNETR, and MedNeXt) without changing their macro-architectures while providing consistent performance gains.

AI.tldr: 提出一种几何导向的局部算子，用于3D医学图像分割中的细长结构（如血管），可在不改变网络宏观架构的情况下提升边界分割质量并减少参数量。
AI.motivation: 传统的encoder-decoder网络（如U-Net）在处理细长解剖结构时存在困难：重复下采样和固定网格卷积会模糊或混叠细结构，早期错误会在多尺度间传播。血管等细长结构的一体素边界误差就可能导致分支断开，改变临床相关拓扑结构。
AI.method: 提出几何导向的局部算子，在单一定义下同时实现特征精化（stride 1）和分辨率降低（stride >1）。该算子在每个体素处预测局部方向和有界步长，沿这些方向对称采样，并将成对样本转换为紧凑的几何和边界线索；跨尺度共识模块在skip连接处对齐encoder和decoder特征以减少几何失配。将其替换3D U-Net中的所有stride 1和stride 2算子。
AI.result: 在BraTS、MSD Hepatic Vessel和TDSC-ABUS数据集上一致提升。在BraTS上：Dice从86.1提升至88.9，HD95从7.1降至6.2；在TDSC-ABUS上：HD95从39.1降至27.8。参数量从2.3M降至0.8M。还能集成到其他backbone（nnU-Net、Swin-UNETR、MedNeXt）中并获得一致性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该几何导向算子能有效提升细长结构的分割质量，在边界指标上提升显著，同时大幅减少参数量，且可作为即插即用模块集成到多种网络架构中，具有良好的通用性。

title: FlowMoDL: Model-Based Deep Learning with Conjugate-Gradient Data Consistency for Highly Accelerated 4D Flow MRI Reconstruction
summary: We present FlowMoDL, an unrolled neural network for highly accelerated 4D flow MRI reconstruction that directly optimizes for both anatomical magnitude and phase-derived velocity accuracy. Building on the MoDL framework, FlowMoDL alternates a learned (3+1)D spatiotemporal denoiser with conjugate-gradient data-consistency updates based on the SENSE forward model. A novel dual-pathway conditioning scheme adapts the denoiser features and data-consistency weighting, enabling a single model to handle varying acceleration factors ($10\times$ to $50\times$). To ensure physiological accuracy, the network is trained using a deep-supervision composite loss that explicitly penalizes velocity magnitude and angular errors, stabilized by a curriculum schedule. We evaluate FlowMoDL on the multi-center CMRx4DFlow dataset against classical and deep-learning baselines (CG-SENSE, MoDL, FlowVN, and FlowMRI-Net). A key advantage of FlowMoDL is its superior gradient step efficiency. When evaluated under an equivalent, limited budget of gradient steps, competing flow-specific networks degrade significantly. In contrast, FlowMoDL robustly converges and strictly outperforms all competitors across all acceleration factors in magnitude SSIM, nRMSE, relative velocity error, and angular error, successfully recovering sharp structural details and temporally coherent velocity fields.

AI.motivation: 4D flow MRI 可以同时采集解剖结构和血流动力学信息，但重建时间较长。该研究旨在实现高加速（10× 至 50×）的 4D flow MRI 重建，同时保持图像质量和速度场精度。现有的深度学习方法在有限梯度步数预算下性能下降显著。
AI.method: 1. 基于 MoDL 框架，构建展开神经网络；2. 交替使用学习的 (3+1)D 时空去噪器和共轭梯度数据一致性更新；3. 引入双路径 conditioning 方案，使单一模型可处理 10× 至 50× 不同加速因子；4. 使用深度监督复合损失函数，明确惩罚速度 magnitude 和角度误差，并采用课程学习 schedule 稳定训练。
AI.result: 在多中心 CMRx4DFlow 数据集上，FlowMoDL 在所有加速因子下均优于 CG-SENSE、MoDL、FlowVN 和 FlowMRI-Net 对比方法。在 magnitude SSIM、nRMSE、相对速度误差和角度误差等指标上全面胜出，能恢复清晰的解剖细节和时间相干的速度场。更重要的是，FlowMoDL 具有卓越的梯度步效率，在有限梯度步预算下仍保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: FlowMoDL 成功实现了一个高效、鲁棒的 4D flow MRI 重建网络，能够处理高加速因子并同时保证图像质量和速度场精度。其双路径 conditioning 设计和深度监督训练策略使其在各种加速条件下均优于现有方法，具有重要的临床应用价值。

title: Socialized Detector Learning: Trajectory-Guided and Reciprocal Distillation for Heterogeneous Object Detectors
summary: Object detection knowledge is fragmented across independently trained, heterogeneous detectors with complementary category supports. In socialized learning, this knowledge resides in a society, and learning aims to evolve the society collectively through exchange. However, aggregation-based socialization does not explicitly plan transfer order, whereas progressive multi-teacher distillation considers order but remains a one-way student enhancement in a shared category space. Building on Socialized Learning, we formulate Socialized Detector Learning (SDL) for heterogeneous, category-specialized object detectors and propose Trajectory-Guided and Reciprocal Distillation (TGRD).TGRD estimates directed operational Inter-Detector Transfer Difficulty (IDTD) from held-out feature-alignment residuals, precomputes a fixed score table, and greedily constructs a carrier trajectory. Along the trajectory, knowledge is progressively consolidated into a union-category carrier and then returned to experts through reciprocal transfer. A conditional proxy-certificate analysis shows that, under stated assumptions, the progressive certificate is no larger than an aggregated-target counterpart. On MS COCO with four heterogeneous experts and two carrier initializations, final carriers outperform epoch-matched simultaneous aggregation controls by 2.6 AP in both settings. Reciprocal detectors attain 20.8--28.4 AP on previously unsupported categories while remaining within 1.3 AP of original expert-specific performance. These results support order-aware progressive consolidation followed by reciprocal transfer as a viable mechanism for detector-society evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Socialized Detector Learning (SDL)框架，用于处理异构、类别专化的目标检测器之间的知识迁移问题，并提出Trajectory-Guided and Reciprocal Distillation (TGRD)方法，通过估计IDTD构建迁移轨迹，实现知识的渐进式整合与双向Reciprocal Transfer。
AI.motivation: 现有方法中，基于聚合的Socialization未明确规划迁移顺序，而渐进式多教师蒸馏虽考虑顺序但仅是单向学生增强且共享类别空间。异构检测器的知识分散在不同专家中，需要一种考虑顺序的渐进式迁移机制。
AI.method: 1) 提出Directed Operational Inter-Detector Transfer Difficulty (IDTD)从保留特征对齐残差中估计；2) 预计算固定分数表，贪心构建迁移轨迹；3) 沿轨迹将知识渐进整合到联合类别载体，然后通过Reciprocal Transfer返还给各专家。
AI.result: 在MS COCO上，使用4个异构专家和2种载体初始化设置，最终载体比同时聚合对照方法高出2.6 AP；Reciprocal检测器在之前不支持的类别上达到20.8-28.4 AP，同时保持与原专家性能在1.3 AP以内。
AI.conclusion: 支持顺序感知的渐进式整合后接Reciprocal Transfer是检测器社会演进的有效机制。

Even though both fields use deep learning, they address completely different problems in different domains.

title: THA-Flow Generative Model: Prosthesis Geometry Prediction from Preoperative CT
summary: Preoperative planning for total hip arthroplasty (THA) is commonly framed as selecting a single prosthesis configuration and placement for a patient's osseous anatomy. In practice, however, the same anatomy may admit several clinically reasonable solutions, making planning inherently a one-to-many problem that is better represented by a conditional probability distribution. We present THA-Flow, a conditional flow-matching model that generates three-dimensional prosthesis geometry directly from preoperative CT. Separate AutoencoderKL models compress preoperative bone anatomy and prosthesis geometry, while a three-dimensional UNet learns a rectified flow from Gaussian noise to the prosthesis latent space under spatial bone conditioning and optional structured prosthesis parameters. The retrospective cohort comprised 1,355 hips from 1,149 patients undergoing primary THA. Following rigid registration of postoperative CT to preoperative CT, the actual postoperative prostheses were transformed independently according to the pelvic and femoral registrations and represented as a dual-channel truncated signed distance field. The prosthesis autoencoder achieved a peak signal-to-noise ratio of 47.11 dB and a structural similarity index of 0.9964 on the validation set. Complete acetabular and femoral geometries were generated across seven major stem models representing 93.4% of the cohort. Repeated bone-conditioned sampling preserved component position, alignment, and the principal bone-prosthesis interfaces while allowing limited local geometric variation. To our knowledge, THA-Flow represents the first application of generative AI to three-dimensional surgical planning for THA.

AI.tldr: THA-Flow是一种条件流匹配模型，可根据术前CT直接生成三维假体几何形状，将全髋关节置换术(THA)术前规划从单一方案选择转变为基于条件概率分布的一对多问题解决。
AI.motivation: 传统THA术前规划通常是为患者骨骼解剖选择单一假体配置，但实际同一解剖结构可能存在多个临床合理解决方案，因此规划本质上是一个一对多问题，更适合用条件概率分布来表示。
AI.method: 使用AutoencoderKL模型分别压缩术前骨骼解剖和假体几何形状；使用三维UNet学习从高斯噪声到假体潜在空间的修正流，并在空间骨骼条件和可选结构化假体参数下进行训练。术后CT经刚性配准后，将实际术后假体按骨盆和股骨配准独立变换，以双通道截断符号距离场表示。
AI.result: 假体自编码器在验证集上达到47.11 dB的峰值信噪比和0.9964的结构相似性指数。成功生成涵盖7种主要柄型号的完整髋臼和股骨几何形状，覆盖93.4%的患者队列。重复骨骼条件采样保留组件位置、对齐和主要骨-假体界面，同时允许有限的局部几何变化。
AI.conclusion: THA-Flow是生成式AI在THA三维手术规划中的首次应用，为术前规划提供了一种基于条件概率分布的解决方案，能够生成多个临床合理的假体配置方案。

title: DEFUSE: Generalizable Backdoor Defense for Self-Supervised Encoders with Generative Priors
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) encoders are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, posing threats to both visual SSL encoders and vision-language encoders. Existing defenses are typically designed for only one of these paradigms and rely on restrictive assumptions such as access to uninfected in-distribution data or precomputed pseudo-labels, which are difficult to satisfy in practice. To address these limitations, we propose DEFUSE, a generalizable backdoor detection framework for SSL encoders. Inspired by Bayesian posterior inference, we reformulate backdoor detection as a representation-conditioned image likelihood estimation problem parameterized by a conditional diffusion generative model. Uninfected representations tend to yield semantically consistent reconstructions, whereas backdoored ones are more likely to be mapped to the attacker's target class or semantically meaningless images, deviating from the original semantics and thereby exposing the backdoor. However, we find that the exact likelihood is intractable, because highly abstracted representations discard the low-level information necessary for pixel-faithful reconstruction. We therefore relax the objective to semantic reconstruction and evaluate it in a well-separated representation space provided by a reference encoder. Rather than training from scratch, we fine-tune a pretrained diffusion model, leveraging its generative prior to map data onto the natural image manifold while preserving semantic content. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DEFUSE substantially outperforms existing detectors across diverse attack settings, generalizing to both visual SSL and vision-language encoders. Notably, our method greatly reduces the reliance on prior knowledge about the victim encoder or the attack strategy. The source code is available at https://github.com/jsrdcht/DEFUSE .

AI.tldr: DEFUSE是一种基于条件扩散生成模型的通用后门检测框架，用于自监督学习编码器。该方法将后门检测重新表述为表示条件图像似然估计问题，利用语义重建来区分正常和后门编码表示。
AI.motivation: 现有防御方法通常仅针对视觉SSL或视觉-语言编码器之一设计，且依赖难以满足的限制性假设（如访问无感染分布数据或预计算的伪标签），需要一种更具通用性的解决方案。
AI.method: 受贝叶斯后验推理启发，将后门检测重新表述为表示条件图像似然估计问题，由条件扩散生成模型参数化。通过语义重建在良好分离的表示空间中评估，利用预训练扩散模型进行微调，将数据映射到自然图像流形同时保留语义内容。
AI.result: DEFUSE在各种攻击设置中显著优于现有检测器，可泛化到视觉SSL和视觉-语言编码器，极大减少了对受害者编码器或攻击策略的先验知识依赖。
AI.conclusion: DEFUSE通过扩散语义重建为SSL编码器提供了一种有效的通用后门检测方法，在不同范式的编码器中均表现出色。

title: Precipitation Downscaling Using Foundation Model-Conditioned Diffusion
summary: High-resolution precipitation fields are essential for hydrological impact assessment, yet global climate model outputs are too coarse and biased for direct use. AI-based statistical downscaling with diffusion models offers a promising approach, but the mechanism by which large-scale atmospheric predictors condition generation remains largely unexplored. We investigate three conditioning strategies for a denoising diffusion probabilistic model applied to daily precipitation downscaling: channel concatenation of upsampled coarse predictors, cross-attention conditioning with a learned convolutional encoder, and cross-attention conditioning with the frozen encoder of the pretrained Prithvi WxC weather foundation model. All strategies are evaluated against an unconditioned baseline under identical conditions using probabilistic, distributional, spectral, and extreme-event metrics for the Colorado River Basin. Concatenation conditioning achieves the lowest point-wise CRPS and MSE, but tends to produce over-smoothed fields that suppress high-intensity events. In contrast, cross-attention conditioning provides substantially better distributional realism and modest improvements in spectral fidelity. Improvements are greatest for extremes: the Prithvi-WxC conditioned model retains over half of >100mm/day events, although estimates are uncertain due to limited samples. When trained on the full dataset, the learned convolutional model performs similarly to the foundation model-conditioned approach while requiring lower computational resources. However, the Prithvi-WxC-conditioned model achieves comparable performance with only five years of training data. These results indicate that cross-attention conditioning offers advantages over simple concatenation for probabilistic precipitation downscaling, and that pre-trained foundation model representations may offer benefits in data-limited settings.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨了三种条件策略在去噪扩散概率模型应用于每日降水统计降尺度中的表现：通道拼接、交叉注意力（可学习卷积编码器）、交叉注意力（Prithvi WxC天气基础模型冻结编码器）。交叉注意力策略在分布真实性和极端事件保留下优于简单拼接，Prithvi-WxC条件模型在数据受限场景下表现优异。
AI.motivation: 全球气候模型输出分辨率太粗且存在偏差，无法直接用于水文影响评估，需要进行降尺度处理。AI驱动的统计降尺度方法虽有前景，但大尺度大气预测因子如何条件化生成过程的机制尚未被深入探索。
AI.method: 在科罗拉多河流域，使用概率、分布、频谱和极端事件指标，在相同条件下评估三种条件策略与无条件基线模型：1) 通道拼接上采样粗预测因子；2) 使用可学习卷积编码器的交叉注意力条件化；3) 使用预训练Prithvi WxC天气基础模型冻结编码器的交叉注意力条件化。

AI.conclusion: 交叉注意力条件化相比简单拼接在概率降水降尺度中具有优势，预训练基础模型表示在数据受限场景下可能提供优势。

title: Learning Late, Guiding Early: Timestep-Decoupled Semantic Guidance for Fair Face Generation
summary: Demographic imbalance in synthetic face generation can propagate to downstream face recognition systems, making fairness an important consideration when diffusion models are used for data generation. Existing fairness-aware generation approaches often require model retraining, architectural modifications, or repeated guidance throughout the reverse diffusion process. In this work, we introduce Semantic Boundary Predictor (SBP), an inference-time framework that performs demographic guidance through a one-shot intervention during reverse denoising. Our approach is motivated by the observation that latent representations at different diffusion timesteps play distinct semantic roles: late-stage latents provide stronger demographic separability, whereas early-stage latents offer greater flexibility for semantic intervention. SBP leverages this timestep decoupling by learning linear semantic boundaries from late-stage latent representations while applying them only once at the initial noisy latent, allowing the remainder of the reverse denoising process to proceed unchanged. The method requires neither retraining nor fine-tuning of the underlying Latent Diffusion Model and operates without external balanced datasets. Experiments on CelebA-HQ demonstrate substantial improvements in demographic fairness, reducing fairness disparity by 98% for gender, 95% for binary race, and 15% for four-class race, while maintaining perceptual image quality across demographic groups. Owing to its one-shot inference strategy and model-agnostic design, SBP introduces only a small computational overhead and can be readily integrated with existing pre-trained latent diffusion models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Semantic Boundary Predictor (SBP)框架，通过在反向去噪过程中一次性干预来提高合成人脸生成的公平性，无需重新训练或微调底层潜在扩散模型。
AI.motivation: 合成人脸生成中的 demographic imbalance 会传播到下游人脸识别系统，使公平性成为重要考量。现有公平性感知生成方法通常需要模型重新训练、架构修改或在反向扩散过程中重复引导。

AI.result: 在CelebA-HQ上展示实质性改进：性别公平性差距减少98%，二元种族减少95%，四类种族减少15%，同时保持各人口统计组的感知图像质量。
AI.conclusion: 由于其一次性推理策略和模型无关设计，SBP仅引入较小计算开销，可轻松集成到现有预训练潜在扩散模型中。

title: LUTSeg: A Longitudinal Multi-Expert Dataset for Ulcer Tissue Segmentation
summary: Quantifying wound tissue composition is essential for monitoring chronic ulcer progression and guiding treatment decisions. However, pixel-level annotations are costly, and multi-tissue wound datasets remain scarce, particularly for neglected diseases such as leprosy. We introduce LUTSeg, a longitudinal chronic ulcer dataset comprising 141 images from 39 patients with wound masks and five tissue categories annotated by five expert clinicians, including a multi-expert gold-standard subset for inter-rater agreement analysis. To establish an initial benchmark for LUTSeg, we further propose TiSage, a semi-supervised tissue segmentation framework that integrates multi-scale semantic priors from a frozen medical vision-language model within a teacher-student architecture. We evaluate TiSage on LUTSeg and DFUTissue, showing improvements over supervised and semi-supervised baselines in most low-label settings. Code & data: https://github.com/carlosh93/TiSage

title: Embedding NDRE Trajectories into Contrastive Learning for Label-Free, Physiology-Aware Crop-Stress Staging and DSS Outputs
summary: Timely detection of crop stress is critical for sustaining yields under increasing drought frequency, yet conventional vegetation index thresholds or image-based clustering often fail to capture stress progression, limiting their value for farm decision-making. To address this gap, we present EigenCL, a physiology-guided contrastive learning framework that stages crop stress from Sentinel-2 NDRE trajectories, with the goal of providing interpretable and transferable stress diagnostics for decision support systems (DSS). EigenCL was trained on 10,000 maize NDRE patches from drought-affected Iowa fields in 2020 and tested on Nebraska fields in 2023 without retraining, with validation incorporating soil-moisture records, U.S. Drought Monitor maps, and county-level yield statistics. The model produced four physiologically coherent stress clusters (Healthy, Mild, Moderate, Severe), significantly outperforming baselines including K-Means, SimCLR, ProtoCLR, and an ablation model (Silhouette = 0.748, DBI = 0.35, CHI = 49,624). Clusters aligned with maize growth stages, with severe stress peaking around tasseling-silking (VT-R1), a stage known to drive yield loss; moreover, EigenCL clusters correlated with soil moisture at 0-14-day lags (rho up to 0.72) and matched yield anomalies in drought-affected counties. By embedding NDRE trajectory dynamics into contrastive learning, EigenCL enables early stress alerts and interpretable DSS outputs (e.g., heatmaps, scouting priorities, regional risk indices), extending beyond single-date NDRE thresholds and supporting scalable monitoring for climate-smart agronomy.

AI.tldr: EigenCL是一种生理引导的对比学习框架，利用Sentinel-2 NDRE轨迹对玉米胁迫进行分期，在无重训练情况下可迁移至新地区，显著优于传统聚类方法，为精准农业决策支持系统提供可解释的胁迫诊断。

title: Visual General Intelligence: A White Paper
summary: This paper reconsiders intelligence from a vision-centered perspective and examines whether intelligence emerging from visual experience and learning may provide a pathway toward AGI. In the language domain, beginning with the introduction of the Transformer architecture, the GPT series has demonstrated transfer to unseen tasks through autoregressive language modeling on web-scale text combined with aggressive scaling. This raises a natural question, namely, what capabilities and forms of intelligence can emerge from visual modalities such as images, videos, and geometry? In this paper, we discuss whether visual intelligence can serve as a pathway toward AGI, referred to in this paper as visual general intelligence (VGI), by bringing together contributors from diverse standpoints and affiliations. Our aim is not to offer a single definition of visual intelligence, but to clarify the principles that computer vision should pursue in the AGI era, the visual input modalities, the benchmarks, the learning paradigms, and the relationship between vision, when taken as the core, and other modalities such as language.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨视觉智能是否能成为通往通用人工智能(AGI)的路径,称为视觉通用智能(VGI)。通过汇集不同领域研究者的观点,本文旨在阐明AGI时代计算机视觉应追求的原则、视觉输入模态、基准测试、学习范式,以及视觉与语言等其他模态的关系。

AI.conclusion: 视觉智能可能成为AGI的重要路径;需要明确视觉智能的定义、原则和评估基准;视觉应作为核心模态与其他模态(尤其是语言)协同发展。

title: Code World Model: Coding Agent as World Brain
summary: World models aim to simulate how complex environments evolve under actions and events, yet existing video-based world models primarily learn dynamics from visual observations, which reveal outcomes rather than the underlying knowledge, rules, and mechanisms governing world evolution. This makes it difficult to maintain persistent consequences and support coherent, open-ended evolution. We introduce Code World Model, a framework that separates world evolution from visual realization by combining the reasoning and coding capabilities of language models with the generative priors of video models. A coding agent serves as the world brain, reasoning about events and their consequences and generating executable code to maintain persistent world state and perform rule-consistent evolution. To connect executable state with visual generation, we introduce a proxy representation that encodes frame-wise spatiotemporal constraints and is compiled into a proxy video, which conditions a video model to render high-fidelity visual observations. We further develop data pipelines for constructing aligned proxy-observation pairs from gameplay and real-world videos. After fine-tuning on paired gameplay data, MiniMax-H3 follows proxy-based spatiotemporal specifications from simple interactive worlds built by the coding agent while preserving rich visual details and dynamics. These results demonstrate the potential of combining code for persistent world evolution with video models for flexible visual realization, providing a new path toward open-ended world models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Code World Model框架，通过将语言模型的推理和编码能力与视频模型的生成先验相结合，分离世界演化与视觉实现。该框架使用编码代理作为世界大脑，通过代码维护持久世界状态，并引入代理表示连接可执行状态与视觉生成。实验表明MiniMax-H3能够遵循基于代理的时空规范，同时保留丰富的视觉细节和动力学特征。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视频的世界模型主要从视觉观测中学习动力学，揭示的是结果而非支撑世界演化的底层知识、规则和机制，难以维持持久的后果并支持连贯、开放的世界演化。
AI.method: 提出Code World Model框架，包含三部分：1) 编码代理作为世界大脑，推理事件及其后果，生成可执行代码维护持久世界状态并执行规则一致的演化；2) 代理表示编码帧级时空约束并编译为代理视频，作为视频模型条件生成高保真视觉观测；3. 开发数据管道从游戏和现实世界视频构建对齐的代理-观测对。
AI.result: 在配对游戏数据上微调后，MiniMax-H3能够遵循编码代理构建的简单交互世界的基于代理的时空规范，同时保留丰富的视觉细节和动力学特征。
AI.conclusion: 结合代码实现持久世界演化与视频模型实现灵活视觉实现的潜力，为开放世界模型提供了新路径。

title: When Composition Doesn't Add Up: Humans Identifying Defects in AI-Generated Images
summary:
*Chulin Zhao and Ruoqi Hu contributed equally to this work.
  State-of-the-art text-to-image (T2I) models exhibit pronounced and systematic defects when prompts involve intricate compositional factors such as multiple entities and multiple attributes. In this paper, we investigate how humans identify such defects. Specifically, we manually select 651 reference images from the four categories of people, hand, object, and scene that exhibit complex compositional characteristics, from which prompts emphasizing compositional factors are derived by manually editing ChatGPT-generated prompts. We then feed the prompts into three selected T2I models to generate AI images and conduct a comprehensive subjective study to identify their defects. For each image, 29 participants provide multi-label assessments specifying defect types and locations. The study yields the compositional AI-generated image defect (CO-AID) dataset, including reference images, prompts, AI-generated images, and information on defect locations and types. Experimental results show that training a deep model on CO-AID can both predict defects in AI-generated images and optimize AI image generation, demonstrating its usability and effectiveness. The database and supplementary materials are available at: https://github.com/Future-IQA/CO-AID .

AI.tldr: 本文构建了Compositional AI-generated Image Defect (CO-AID)数据集,用于研究和分析文本到图像(T2I)模型在处理复杂组合因素(多个实体、多个属性)时出现的系统性缺陷。通过人工标注方式收集了651张参考图像及其对应提示词,并让29名参与者对3个T2I模型生成的图像进行多标签评估,标注缺陷类型和位置。
AI.motivation: 当前最先进的文本到图像(T2I)模型在处理复杂的组合因素(如多个实体和多个属性)时存在明显且系统性的缺陷,但尚不清楚人类如何识别这些缺陷,因此需要构建一个系统的数据集来研究和理解这一问题。
AI.method: 从人物、手部、物体和场景四类中手动选取651张具有复杂组合特征的参考图像,通过手动编辑ChatGPT生成的提示词来强调组合因素。将提示词输入三个T2I模型生成AI图像,进行综合主观研究以识别缺陷。每幅图像由29名参与者提供多标签评估,标注缺陷类型和位置。
AI.result: 实验表明,在CO-AID数据集上训练深度模型可以预测AI生成图像中的缺陷,并能优化AI图像生成，验证了数据集的可用性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: CO-AID数据集能够支持对T2I模型组合缺陷的深入研究,为改进图像生成质量提供了重要基准,且该数据集已开源供研究使用。

title: TAU-Agent: An Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Traffic Anomaly Understanding
summary: Traffic Anomaly Understanding (TAU) requires models and systems to detect, reason about, and explain anomalous events in transportation videos. To address this challenge, we propose TAU-Agent, an agentic retrieval-augmented framework for traffic anomaly understanding. Given a task query, a central retrieval agent orchestrates two visual perception tools, namely a Video Captioning Tool and an Open-Vocabulary Tracking Tool, to retrieve and select query-relevant evidence, including captions, temporal intervals, and object trajectories. The selected evidence, together with sampled video frames and the input query, is provided to a supervised fine-tuned vision-language model for final reasoning and answer generation. We evaluate TAU-Agent on both the in-domain and the out-of-domain benchmarks from the AI City Challenge 2026. TAU-Agent achieves scores of 0.6779 on Track 3, 0.3998 on Track 7, and 67.9275 on Track 8, ranking second, twelfth, and fifth, respectively. Code is available at: https://github.com/siri-rouser/TAU-Agent.

AI.tldr: TAU-Agent是一个用于交通异常理解的智能体检索增强框架。该系统通过中央检索代理协调视频字幕工具和开放词汇跟踪工具来检索相关证据（字幕、时间间隔、物体轨迹），并结合采样视频帧和输入查询由微调的视觉语言模型进行最终推理和答案生成。在AI City Challenge 2026的三个赛道测试中分别获得第2名、第12名和第5名的成绩。
AI.motivation: 交通异常理解（TAU）需要模型和系统能够检测、推理和解释交通视频中的异常事件。现有方法在处理复杂交通场景和进行深层次推理方面存在挑战，需要一个能够整合多模态信息并进行智能推理的框架。
AI.method: 提出TAU-Agent框架，包含以下核心组件：1）中央检索代理，负责协调两个视觉感知工具；2）视频字幕工具，用于生成视频描述；3）开放词汇跟踪工具，用于追踪物体轨迹；4）监督微调的视觉语言模型，用于最终推理和答案生成。系统输入任务查询后，检索代理选择相关的字幕、时间间隔和物体轨迹证据，结合采样视频帧和查询语句，由视觉语言模型生成最终答案。
AI.result: 在AI City Challenge 2026的基准测试中，TAU-Agent取得如下成绩：Track 3得分0.6779（排名第2），Track 7得分0.3998（排名第12），Track 8得分67.9275（排名第5）。
AI.conclusion: TAU-Agent作为一个智能体检索增强框架，能够有效整合视频字幕、物体跟踪等多模态信息进行交通异常理解，在多个赛道展现了竞争力，但不同赛道的表现存在差异，表明该框架在某些场景下仍有改进空间。

title: Auditable CT Phenotyping Through Report-derived Radiological Observations
summary: Medical image foundation models can predict clinical phenotypes from computed tomography (CT), but strong performance leaves open whether they read disease-specific findings or shortcuts that correlate with the diagnosis. We tested this in 221 electronic-health-record (EHR) phenotypes using Auditable CT phenotyping (ACT), built on report-derived radiological observations. We trained ACT on 38,317 patients, mined 376,194 observations and evaluated it in 25,183 held-out patients. ACT exceeded five vision-language baselines on zero-shot annotation, and CT-CLIP across 221 phenotypes from unseen CT pulmonary angiography, both under zero-shot scoring (0.651 versus 0.572) and under linear probing (0.709 versus 0.662). Reading each probe exposes what accuracy conceals: only 97 observations occupy the 221 rank-1 positions, and one phrase describing aortic and coronary calcification ranks first for 20 phenotypes, including osteoporosis, urinary tract infection and major depressive disorder. Restricting the bank to clinician-specified evidence redirects those probes onto phenotype-related observations in 86 phenotypes at no accuracy cost (0.751 versus 0.741). Accurate CT-based EHR phenotyping can therefore rest on observations that are not valid evidence for the coded phenotype and that ACT can identify and intervene on.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了医学影像基础模型在CT图像预测临床表型时是否读取疾病特异性发现还是走捷径（相关性）。提出Auditable CT phenotyping (ACT)方法，基于报告衍生的放射学观察进行训练评估。
AI.motivation: 医学影像基础模型在CT图像上表现出色，但高性能掩盖了一个关键问题：模型读取的是疾病特异性发现还是仅与诊断相关的捷径特征？
AI.method: 构建ACT系统，基于报告衍生的放射学观察训练，在38,317例患者上训练，挖掘376,194个观察，在25,183例保留患者上评估221个EHR表型。采用零样本标注和线性探测两种方式进行评估。
AI.result: ACT在零样本标注上超越五个视觉语言基线；在221个表型上超越CT-CLIP（零样本0.651 vs 0.572，线性探测0.709 vs 0.662）。关键发现：仅97个观察占据221个排名第一位；一个关于主动脉和冠状动脉钙化的短语在20个表型中排名第一（包括骨质疏松、尿路感染、抑郁症）。限制为临床医生指定的证据后，86个表型重定向到表型相关观察，准确率无损失（0.751 vs 0.741）。
AI.conclusion: 准确的CT基础EHR表型预测可能基于非有效证据的观察，ACT可以识别并干预这些捷径，提供可解释的医学影像AI系统。

title: 4DGS-WAM: Bridging Past and Future with an Object-Centric World Action Model based on 4D Gaussian Splatting
comment: This is a work in progress
summary: Current world action models (WAMs) typically operate on 2D visual data. These models can achieve exceptional visual quality, but they lack explicit spatial structure for individual objects and repeatedly process redundant background content. Although point clouds can represent the world in 3D space, they can be difficult to align and accumulate across viewpoints. In this paper, we leverage an explicit 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) representation that separately models dynamic objects and the static background of a scene. For dynamic objects, we use a policy model to predict future actor actions and a world model to predict transformations of their observed Gaussian splats. The static background need not be regenerated for future states, as much of it has already been observed in past frames. This forms an object-centric world action model, which we name 4DGS-WAM. It lifts 2D observations into a persistent 4D representation so that previously observed static content can be reused during future prediction. Future-state extrapolation can then focus on modeling the evolution of dynamic objects. Experiments on KITTI-MOT evaluate short-horizon prediction and past reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出4DGS-WAM，一种基于4D Gaussian Splatting的对象中心世界动作模型，通过将2D观测提升到持久4D表示，实现静态背景复用和动态对象预测的分离。
AI.motivation: 现有的世界动作模型(WAMs)通常在2D视觉数据上操作，虽然可以达到优异的视觉质量，但缺乏单个对象的显式空间结构，并且重复处理冗余的背景内容。虽然点云可以在3D空间中表示世界，但它们难以跨视角对齐和累积。
AI.method: 提出一种对象中心的4D Gaussian Splatting世界动作模型(4DGS-WAM)。该方法使用显式的4DGS表示，将动态对象和静态背景分开建模。对于动态对象，使用策略模型预测未来actor动作，使用世界模型预测观测到的高斯splat的变换。静态背景不需要为未来状态重新生成，因为大部分内容已在过去的帧中观测到。
AI.result: 该方法在KITTI-MOT数据集上评估了短视野预测和过去重建任务。
AI.conclusion: 4DGS-WAM通过将2D观测提升到持久的4D表示，使先前观测到的静态内容可以在未来预测中重复使用，未来状态外推可以专注于建模动态对象的演变。在KITTI-MOT数据集上进行了短视野预测和过去重建的实验验证。

title: Less Contouring, More Accuracy: Lesion-Guided ROI Deep Learning for Ovarian Ultrasound Classification

summary: Ovarian lesion classification using transvaginal ultrasound remains challenging due to overlapping imaging characteristics and the dependence on expert interpretation. This study investigates whether lesion-guided region-of-interest (ROI) deep learning can achieve competitive diagnostic performance while reducing the annotation burden associated with pixel-level lesion segmentation. Two publicly available ovarian ultrasound datasets were evaluated: the Multi-Modality Ovarian Tumor Ultrasound (MMOTU) dataset for eight-class classification and the Ovarian Ultrasound Dataset (OUD) for binary classification. Four strategies were compared under a unified framework: global image-based deep learning, lesion-guided ROI-based deep learning, lesion contour-based deep learning, and contour-based radiomics with machine learning classifiers. Four deep learning architectures, MaxViT-Tiny, Swin Transformer, EfficientNet-B7, and ResNet18, were evaluated. Radiomics models were developed using support vector machine, k-nearest neighbors, and artificial neural network classifiers, with ANOVA-based feature selection applied for the lower-sample OUD dataset. The lesion-guided ROI strategy achieved the strongest overall performance, with MaxViT-Tiny obtaining 93.10% accuracy and an AUC of 0.99 on MMOTU and 97.56% accuracy and an AUC of 0.99 on OUD. The contour-based approach achieved comparable accuracy but required substantially higher annotation effort. These findings demonstrate that lesion-guided ROI deep learning provides an effective balance between diagnostic performance and annotation efficiency, offering a practical approach for scalable AI-assisted ovarian ultrasound analysis

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种 lesion-guided ROI 深度学习方法，用于卵巢超声病变的分类，在减少像素级标注负担的同时实现高诊断性能。在 MMOTU 数据集上达到 93.10% 准确率和 0.99 AUC，在 OUD 数据集上达到 97.56% 准确率和 0.99 AUC。
AI.motivation: 卵巢超声图像特征重叠且依赖专家解读，导致卵巢病变分类困难。同时，像素级病变分割需要大量标注工作，限制了深度学习方法的临床应用。
AI.method: 在统一框架下比较四种策略：1) 全局图像深度学习；2) 病变引导 ROI 深度学习；3) 病变轮廓深度学习；4) 轮廓放射组学结合机器学习分类器。评估四种深度学习架构（MaxViT-Tiny、Swin Transformer、EfficientNet-B7、ResNet18）和三种放射组学分类器（SVM、KNN、ANN）。
AI.result: 病变引导 ROI 策略表现最佳，MaxViT-Tiny 在 MMOTU 上准确率 93.10%、AUC 0.99，在 OUD 上准确率 97.56%、AUC 0.99。轮廓方法准确率相当但需要更高的标注工作量。
AI.conclusion: 病变引导 ROI 深度学习在诊断性能和标注效率之间提供了有效平衡，为可扩展的 AI 辅助卵巢超声分析提供了实用方案。

title: PANDA - Prototype-Anchored Alignment for Partially Unpaired Multimodal Learning, with Applications to Alzheimers MRI and TCGA Pathology
summary: Multimodal medical prediction often faces incomplete pairing: auxiliary modalities with complementary signal are available for only a subset of subjects (or none) and cannot be assumed at deployment. We introduce PANDA (Prototype Anchored Data Alignment), a two-stage framework that transfers auxiliary information to a primary-modality model without auxiliary inputs at inference. Stage 1 learns a shared embedding from the paired subset and estimates class prototypes from auxiliary modalities; Stage 2 trains the primary encoder on all subjects using cross-entropy plus alignment to the frozen prototypes. Because supervision is defined at the class-prototype level, PANDA accommodates arbitrary pairing rates, including zero subject overlap. We evaluate PANDA on two applications. On a 1,021-subject multi-scanner ADNI cohort, we perform AD/CN classification with three auxiliary modalities at distinct pairing rates: tabular scores (44.8%), FDG-PET (18.7%), and external handwriting kinematics (0% overlap). Relative to the same-backbone MRI-only baseline, PANDA attains AUC 0.868 +-0.020 (+7.9pp) and reduces 1.5T CN false positives by 24.3pp; on a fully trainable Conv5-FC3 backbone it reaches AUC 0.893 (best overall). A pairing-rate ablation shows that the joint anchor remains within seed noise from 75% to 5% pairing. On TCGA-Lung survival prediction from whole-slide images with RNA-seq as auxiliary data, PANDA improves over WSI-only on 2-year OS (AUC +3.5pp) and Cox PH (C-index +9.0pts) and outperforms full-fusion training, which underperforms WSI-only, while requiring no RNA at inference; wide confidence intervals on this smaller cohort keep the gains below conventional significance. Overall, PANDA provides a deployment-oriented mechanism for leveraging incomplete auxiliary modalities to improve primary-modality prediction.

AI.tldr: PANDA（原型锚定数据对齐）是一种两阶段框架，用于在推理时不需要辅助模态输入的情况下，将辅助信息迁移到主模态模型。该方法通过学习共享嵌入估计类别原型，并在所有受试者上训练主编码器，可处理任意配对率（包括零重叠）。
AI.motivation: 多模态医学预测中经常面临不完整配对问题：辅助模态仅对部分受试者可用，且在部署时无法假设其存在。现有方法难以处理任意配对率的情况。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：阶段1从配对子集学习共享嵌入并从辅助模态估计类别原型；阶段2使用交叉熵加上与冻结原型的对齐来训练主编码器。由于监督在类别原型层面定义，可容纳任意配对率。
AI.result: 在ADNI队列（1021名受试者）上，PANDA相对于MRI-only基线达到AUC 0.868±0.020（+7.9pp），降低1.5T CN假阳性24.3pp；最佳达AUC 0.893。在TCGA-Lung数据集上，2年OS的AUC提升3.5pp，Cox PH的C-index提升9.0pts。配对率 ablation显示在75%到5%配对率下联合锚点保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: PANDA提供了一种面向部署的机制，无需推理时的辅助模态即可利用不完整的辅助模态改善主模态预测，为实际临床应用提供了可行方案。

title: FRAME: separating sampling variation from representational cause in medical imaging fairness
summary: Subgroup performance differences are the standard evidence for fairness bias in medical imaging, and the usual response removes the demographic information that a model encodes. Here we introduce Fair-model Reference And Mechanism Evaluation (FRAME), a two-step framework for auditing such a claim. The first step derives a fair-model reference, the distribution of the difference under exact fairness at the observed subgroup sizes. In the second step, we test the remainder with two operators in representation space. One operator cannot change a within-group ranking by construction. Across 702,206 images and 36 encoders, the reference accounts for a median 41% of the reported race difference and 22% of the age difference. Injecting demographic decodability leaves the remainder unchanged, while entangling the group with the disease direction raises the race difference from 0.077 to 0.118. No intervention we tested changes the remainder more than a change of random seed does. Those interventions reduce a difference at the operating point and leave the within-group ranking difference at a median of 0.000. Applied to 89 differences in 9 published studies across 6 medical imaging modalities, the reference accounts for a median 25% of a rate difference and 70% of a difference in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve. Image-text pretraining instead raises worst-group performance by about 0.05. Applying FRAME before choosing an intervention could distinguish differences that need a mechanistic explanation from differences compatible with sampling variation at the current cohort sizes.

AI.tldr: FRAME是一个两步框架，用于审计医学影像中的公平性偏差声称。第一步推导公平模型参考（fair-model reference），即在观察到的亚组规模下精确公平时差异的分布。第二步在表示空间中用两个算子测试剩余差异。
AI.motivation: 当前医学影像中通常使用亚组性能差异作为公平性偏差的证据，但这些差异可能部分来自采样变化而非真正的偏差。当前方法直接移除模型编码的人口统计信息，缺少对偏差来源的精确审计。
AI.method: FRAME框架包含两步：第一步，基于观察到的亚组规模，在精确公平条件下推导差异分布作为参考；第二步，在表示空间中用两个算子测试剩余差异。其中一个算子在结构上无法改变组内排名。
AI.result: 在702,206张图像和36个编码器上，参考解释了报告的种族差异中位数41%和年龄差异中位数22%。注入人口统计可解码性保持剩余差异不变，而将组与疾病方向纠缠使种族差异从0.077增至0.118。测试的干预措施均未比随机种子变化更能改变剩余差异。应用于9项已发表研究的89个差异（6种医学影像模式），参考解释了率差异中位数25%和AUC差异中位数70%。图像-文本预训练使最差组性能提升约0.05。
AI.conclusion: 在选择干预措施之前应用FRAME可以区分需要机械解释的差异与当前队列规模下与采样变化兼容的差异。这为公平性审计提供了更精确的方法，避免了不必要的干预。

title: Uncertainty-Guided Latent Diffusion Models for Faithful Super Resolution
summary: The perception-distortion trade-off poses a fundamental challenge in single-image super-resolution (SR). Although diffusion-based SR methods excel at generating perceptually realistic images, achieving high fidelity remains a key limitation. Recent advances in diffusion-based SR have shown promise in improving fidelity, but these methods often compromise perceptual quality due to their high reliance on a high-fidelity image. To address this, we introduce UGDiff, a novel diffusion guidance paradigm designed to further improve the perception-distortion balance. In particular, we first estimate the reconstruction uncertainty of the latent features corresponding to a high-fidelity image. This uncertainty is then used to guide the diffusion process to selectively restore high-frequency details in high-uncertainty regions, while preserving fidelity elsewhere. Furthermore, our guidance method adaptively identifies the high-uncertainty regions by considering not only the estimated uncertainty but also the posterior variance of the diffusion sampler at each timestep. This relaxes the reliance on the high-fidelity image in the later stages of sampling, thereby achieving a better perception-distortion balance. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method performs favorably against state-of-the-art diffusion-based SR methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UGDiff，一种基于扩散引导的单图像超分辨率新方法，通过估计重建不确定性来平衡感知质量与保真度之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 感知-保真度权衡是单图像超分辨率中的基本挑战。现有的扩散方法虽能生成感知真实的图像，但难以实现高保真度；而强调保真度的方法又往往牺牲感知质量。
AI.method: 首先估计与高保真图像对应的潜在特征的重建不确定性；然后利用该不确定性引导扩散过程，选择性地在高不确定性区域恢复高频细节，同时在其他区域保持保真度；此外，方法还自适应地结合估计的不确定性和扩散采样器在每个时间步的后验方差来识别高不确定性区域，从而在采样后期降低对高保真图像的依赖。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在感知-保真度平衡方面表现优于现有的先进扩散超分辨率方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入不确定性引导的扩散范式，UGDiff能够自适应地平衡感知质量与保真度，为扩散超分辨率提供了一种有效的改进思路。

title: UltraPIPS: Improving model perception in B-mode ultrasound with foundation models
summary: In medical imaging, it is common to use learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) to compare images semantically in feature space. Although backbones pretrained on natural images are widely used for LPIPS computation, B-mode ultrasound images possess distinct speckle patterns and acoustic-specific image statistics that are fundamentally different from natural images and even from other images in radiology. Consequently, we propose that domain-specific models are needed to measure perceptual similarity in ultrasound data, a finding which is not necessarily the case for other imaging modalities. We compare LPIPS metrics across downstream tasks like classification, segmentation and reconstruction using natural image, medical generalist and ultrasound backbone models and show that selection of LPIPS backbone is a non-trivial design choice. In particular, the ultrasound backbone models were more correlated with downstream performance of supervised models than classical and natural image models, and optimization of the LPIPS loss with an ultrasound backbone achieved a strong balance between reconstruction quality and realism. Our code is available at https://github.com/talg2324/UltraPIPS and introduces the UltraPIPS library, a set of LPIPS metrics based on the open-source foundation models analyzed in this paper.

AI.tldr: 研究提出在医学超声影像中，使用自然图像预训练的LPIPS感知相似度度量可能不适用，因为超声图像具有独特的散斑模式和声学特定图像统计特征。实验表明，特定领域的超声骨干模型比传统模型和自然图像模型与下游任务性能更相关。
AI.motivation: 自然图像预训练的模型被广泛用于计算LPIPS，但B型超声图像具有独特的散斑模式和声学特定图像统计特征，与自然图像和放射学其他图像有本质区别，因此需要领域特定的模型来测量超声数据中的感知相似度。
AI.method: 在不同下游任务（分类、分割、重建）上比较了使用自然图像、医学通用和超声骨干模型的LPIPS指标，并使用超声骨干模型优化LPIPS损失进行重建实验。
AI.result: 超声骨干模型比经典模型和自然图像模型与监督模型的下游性能更具相关性；使用超声骨干模型优化LPIPS损失在重建质量和真实感之间取得了良好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: LPIPS骨干模型的选择是一个重要的设计选择，超声特定模型对于超声影像的感知相似度测量至关重要，UltraPIPS库的引入为该领域提供了实用的工具。

title: MyoMechanix: Biomechanically-Grounded Compositional Skilled Activity Understanding and Coaching
summary: Existing action quality assessment (AQA) datasets and methods rely primarily on visual inputs such as RGB and pose, overlooking physiological dynamics such as muscle mechanics and often modeling actions as monolithic patterns. These limitations hinder fine-grained, biomechanically grounded feedback. We introduce MyoMechanix, a multimodal ecosystem for weight-loaded actions that aligns motion with muscle activity. Expert-annotated, it contains 7,500+ samples of 20 actions from 38 subjects, with synchronized multiview RGB video, 3D pose, sEMG, and additional physiological signals, forming the largest multimodal AQA benchmark to date. We further construct the Fitness Knowledge Graph (FKG), which organizes expert annotations into structured relationships among actions, phases, key steps, errors, and corrective feedback, enabling compositional scoring and interpretable assessment. Building on these representations, we develop CUBIST (Compositional Ontological Reasoning Engine), which performs decomposition-analysis-recomposition for fine-grained error attribution and feedback generation. We also establish MyoMechanix-AQA, MyoMechanix-VideoQA, and a novel MyoMechanix-Video2EMG task. Experiments show that multimodal sensing and structured representations improve performance, interpretability, and error attribution, with CUBIST achieving state-of-the-art results; VideoQA enhances language-grounded action understanding; and Video2EMG suggests video-based alternatives to costly EMG sensing. MyoMechanix advances skilled activity understanding toward biomechanically grounded, multimodal, and compositional reasoning for Physical AI applications in fitness, rehabilitation, healthcare, and machine learning. Project page: https://haoyin116.github.io/MyoMechanix/

AI.tldr: 本文提出MyoMechanix，一个多模态生态系统，用于评估负重动作质量。该数据集包含7500+样本、20种动作、38个受试者，同步采集多视角RGB视频、3D姿态、表面肌电(sEMG)和其他生理信号，是目前最大的多模态动作质量评估基准。作者还构建了健身知识图谱(FKG)来组织动作、阶段、关键步骤、错误和纠正反馈之间的关系，开发了CUBIST系统进行分解-分析-重构，实现细粒度错误归因和反馈生成。实验表明多模态感知和结构化表示可提升性能、可解释性和错误归因，CUBIST达到最先进结果。
AI.motivation: 现有动作质量评估(AQA)数据集和方法主要依赖RGB和姿态等视觉输入，忽略了肌肉力学等生理动力学，且通常将动作建模为整体模式。这些局限性阻碍了细粒度、生物力学基础的反馈生成。
AI.method: 1)构建MyoMechanix多模态数据集，包含多视角RGB视频、3D姿态、sEMG和生理信号；2)构建健身知识图谱(FKG)组织动作、阶段、关键步骤、错误和纠正反馈的结构化关系；3)开发CUBIST(组合本体推理引擎)，采用分解-分析-重构策略进行细粒度错误归因和反馈生成；4)定义三个任务：MyoMechanix-AQA、MyoMechanix-VideoQA和MyoMechanix-Video2EMG。
AI.result: 多模态感知和结构化表示提升了性能、可解释性和错误归因能力；CUBIST达到最先进结果；VideoQA增强了语言基础的动作理解；Video2EMG表明视频可以成为肌电感应的可行替代方案。
AI.conclusion: MyoMechanix推动了技能活动理解向生物力学基础、多模态和组合推理方向发展，为健身、康复、医疗和Physical AI应用提供了新范式。

title: StreamPI: Streaming Multimodal Temporal Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated effectiveness in robot manipulation, yet state-of-the-art models such as pi0.5 operate under a single-frame paradigm, limiting their ability to retain past observations and develop precise spatial perception. In this paper, we propose StreamPI, a streaming multimodal temporal modeling framework that equips single-frame VLA with temporal reasoning capability without introducing any additional parameters. One core design is instruction-anchored temporal modeling. It treats each (visual observation, language instruction) pair as an atomic temporal unit: bidirectional attention within each pair enables cross-modal fusion, while causal attention across pairs preserves autoregressive streaming inference. This ensures the language instruction serves as a persistent semantic anchor throughout task execution. To bridge the gap between synchronous training and asynchronous real-robot deployment, we introduce a andom-interval streaming training strategy: a proper inter-frame interval (e.g., every 3 frames) enables faster and smoother action execution. Beyond this, randomizing the interval further improves robustness to frame-timing perturbations, supporting asynchronous deployment in practice. Furthermore, by leveraging the length extrapolation capability of the LLM backbone, StreamPI seamlessly inherits pretrained single-frame weights and supports flexible single-frame and multi-frame inference. Experiments on real-robot tasks spanning memory-dependent and precise perception scenarios, as well as the simulation benchmark LIBERO, demonstrate that StreamPI outperforms pi0.5 across diverse tasks.

AI.tldr: StreamPI是一个流式多模态时间建模框架，为单帧VLA模型赋予时间推理能力，无需额外参数。通过指令锚定的时间建模和随机间隔流式训练策略，实现连续观察保持和精确空间感知。
AI.motivation: 当前最先进的VLA模型（如pi0.5）采用单帧范式，限制了保留过去观察和发展精确空间感知的能力，需要一种无需额外参数的时间推理能力增强方法。
AI.method: 1. 指令锚定的时间建模：将每个（视觉观察、语言指令）对作为原子时间单元，双向注意力实现跨模态融合，因果注意力保持自回归流式推理；2. 随机间隔流式训练策略：使用适当的帧间间隔（如每3帧）实现更快更平滑的动作执行，随机化间隔提高对帧时间扰动的鲁棒性；3. 利用LLM骨干的长度外推能力，继承预训练单帧权重。
AI.result: 在真实机器人任务（记忆依赖和精确感知场景）以及模拟基准LIBERO上，StreamPI在多样化任务中优于pi0.5。
AI.conclusion: StreamPI成功为单帧VLA模型添加了时间推理能力，无需额外参数，支持灵活的单帧和多帧推理，在机器人操作任务中展现出优于现有最先进方法的性能。

The pain points in the research profile focus on video-to-3D human motion transformation and quality control in motion generation, whereas StreamPI addresses temporal reasoning for robot manipulation tasks. The methods, despite some overlap in terminology (VLM, attention mechanisms), serve entirely different purposes - robotics control vs. graphics motion synthesis.

title: A Visual Dependence-Aware Framework for Multimodal Unsupervised Continual Post-Training
summary: In this paper, we explore a novel task of Multimodal Unsupervised Continual Post-Training (MU-CPT), enabling deployed MLLMs to continually evolve from streaming unlabeled data. Existing unsupervised post-training methods for MLLMs typically optimize target tokens uniformly, overlooking their heterogeneous visual dependence (VD). However, we reveal that token-level VD is crucial for MU-CPT. Specifically, its structural distortion serves as an indicator of cross-modal catastrophic forgetting, and its inherent heterogeneity acts as a compass to guide new-task learning. Leveraging this property, we propose a Visual Dependence-Aware (VDA) framework with two main components. First, Visually Constrained Optimal Transport (VC-OT) formulates the VD structural distortion of old-task VD during new-task learning as an optimal transport problem to mitigate cross-modal forgetting. By designing a region-aware ground cost and a dependence-stratified transport penalty, it prevents global shifts in visual focus while strictly prohibiting visual reliance from degenerating into language bias. Second, Visually Modulated Adaptation (VMA) exploits VD heterogeneity to emphasize visually grounded new-task learning, promoting new-task plasticity. Together, our method simultaneously maintains old-task stability and new-task plasticity during challenging MU-CPT. Extensive experiments under our MU-CPT setting validate the effectiveness of VDA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多模态无监督持续后训练(MU-CPT)任务，利用token级视觉依赖(VD)特性解决跨模态灾难性遗忘问题。提出视觉依赖感知(VDA)框架，包含视觉约束最优传输(VC-OT)和视觉调制适应(VMA)两个组件。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督后训练方法对目标token均匀优化，忽视了其异质性视觉依赖(VD)。作者发现token级VD的结构扭曲可作为跨模态灾难性遗忘的指标，其固有异质性可指导新任务学习。

title: VBVR-Pro: A Scalable and Verifiable Suite for Native Visual Reasoning
summary: Native visual reasoning treats visual generation as the medium of reasoning itself: visual states (i.e. images and videos) are not merely inputs to be understood or outputs to be rendered, but first-class substrates for problem solving beyond language. Yet progress remains bottlenecked by the lack of scalable training tasks, reliable feedback, and controlled comparisons across generative substrates. In this work, we introduce VBVR-Pro, a closed-loop testbed that makes native visual reasoning through generation trainable, verifiable, optimizable, and experimentally controllable. 1) Task scaling. VBVR-Pro turns visual reasoning into a controlled task space of 300 procedurally generated tasks. Models trained on VBVR-Pro show strong transfer beyond the proposed suite across seven external visual reasoning benchmarks such as RISE-Video, MME-CoF-Pro, and BabyVision. 2) Verifiable rewards. VBVR-Pro provides verifiable reward scorers for task-grounded evaluation. Through a systematic study of leading MLLMs as judges, we identify recurring failure modes of the prevalent VLM-as-a-judge paradigm. In contrast, the proposed scorers are grounded in deterministic, task-specific rules, achieve fine-grained alignment with human judgments. Importantly, they serve as reliable reward signals for large-scale multi-task reinforcement learning and demonstrate stronger post-RL performance across visual reasoning tasks. 3) Mechanism study. VBVR-Pro enables controlled modality studies across more than 30 image, video, and interleaved generators. Our analysis shows that video generation remains strongest for tasks requiring persistent spatiotemporal state tracking, while interleaved generation provides a compute-efficient alternative. Critically, ablations and probing suggest the presence of vision-native trajectories that are crucial to visual reasoning. We release all data, models, scorers, and code.

AI.tldr: VBVR-Pro是一个原生视觉推理的闭环测试平台，通过300个程序生成的任务、可验证的奖励机制和跨30+生成器的控制实验，使视觉生成本身成为推理媒介。
AI.motivation: 原生视觉推理将视觉状态（图像和视频）视为推理的一阶媒介，而非仅是理解输入或渲染输出。但该领域进展受限于缺乏可扩展的训练任务、可靠的反馈和跨生成基底的对照比较。
AI.method: 1) 任务扩展：构建300个程序化生成任务，用于训练并迁移到7个外部视觉推理基准；2) 可验证奖励：设计基于确定性任务规则的奖励评分器，替代VLM-as-a-judge范式；3) 机制研究：跨图像、视频和交错生成器进行控制模态研究。
AI.result: 模型在VBVR-Pro上训练后展现出强大的迁移能力，可泛化到RISE-Video、MME-CoF-Pro、BabyVision等外部基准。视频生成在需要持续时空状态跟踪的任务中表现最佳，交错生成是计算效率的替代方案。探针分析表明存在对视觉推理至关重要的视觉原生轨迹。
AI.conclusion: VBVR-Pro成功使原生视觉推理变得可训练、可验证、可优化和可实验控制，为视觉推理研究提供了标准化测试平台和可靠评估框架。

title: RefVideo-6M: A Reliable Reference-Based Dataset for Instructional Video Editing
summary: Recent advances in video editing have been largely driven by large-scale instruction-based datasets. However, existing datasets still suffer from two critical limitations. First, target videos are commonly produced by automatic editing models, which may introduce visible artifacts and unreliable supervision signals. Second, most public datasets rely primarily on textual instructions, while lacking visual references that are crucial for precise, identity-preserving, and controllable editing. To address these limitations, we introduce RefVideo-6M, a large-scale reference-guided editing dataset containing 5 million video editing samples and 1 million image editing samples. To ensure reliable supervision, our dataset uses a construction pipeline that treats artifact-free real videos as editing targets and generates quality-filtered input conditions with multiple editing experts. In addition, it provides approximately 6 million visual references, covering diverse reference types and editing scenarios, thereby enabling models to learn fine-grained visual correspondence beyond text-only instructions. Based on RefVideo-6M, we further train a reference-guided video editing model, Ref-MoT, to evaluate the effectiveness and scalability of the proposed dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RefVideo-6M provides substantially more reliable supervision than existing datasets and enables the training of powerful editing models with improved visual quality, controllability, and reference consistency. The open-source dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/RefVideo6M/RefVideo6M.

AI.tldr: RefVideo-6M是一个大规模参考引导的视频编辑数据集，包含500万个视频编辑样本和100万个图像编辑样本，旨在解决现有数据集依赖自动编辑模型导致伪影、缺乏视觉参考的问题。基于该数据集训练了Ref-MoT参考引导视频编辑模型，实验表明该数据集能提供更可靠的监督信号，显著提升编辑模型的视觉质量、可控性和参考一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑数据集存在两个关键局限性：1）目标视频由自动编辑模型生成，可能引入可见伪影和不可靠的监督信号；2）大多数公开数据集主要依赖文本指令，缺乏对精确、可控保身份编辑至关重要的视觉参考。
AI.method: 1）构建流程：使用无伪影的真实视频作为编辑目标，通过多个编辑专家生成质量过滤的输入条件；2）提供约600万个视觉参考，涵盖多样化的参考类型和编辑场景；3）基于RefVideo-6M训练Ref-MoT参考引导视频编辑模型
AI.result: 1）RefVideo-6M提供比现有数据集更可靠的监督信号；2）训练出的编辑模型在视觉质量、可控性和参考一致性方面有显著提升
AI.conclusion: RefVideo-6M数据集能够支持训练更强大的编辑模型，推动参考引导视频编辑领域的发展。
